cases.description: 6 RSS articles covering both topics (3 each), with 2 thin snippets (<80 chars) that should trigger fetch_article_content and 4 rich snippets that should be skipped.

articles.title: Open-weight reasoning model DeepSeek-R2-Lite released
articles.snippet: New open-weight reasoning model released today.

articles.title: Google ADK v2.15 ships new agent evaluation harness
articles.snippet: Google released an updated ADK framework with eval tools.

articles.title: OpenAI cuts structured output latency and pricing for GPT-5 Mini
articles.snippet: OpenAI announced a 30% price reduction and faster constrained JSON decoding for GPT-5 Mini across batch and real-time API endpoints, detailing benchmark results on function calling, extraction accuracy, and long-context retrieval across enterprise workloads.

articles.title: Anthropic expands prompt caching window and tool schemas in Claude Haiku
articles.snippet: Anthropic rolled out extended 1-hour prompt caching and strict tool-use validation for Claude Haiku, reporting up to 65% input token cost savings for repetitive document classification and customer support routing agents in production deployments.

articles.title: LangGraph v3 adds deterministic state checkpoints for resumable tool agents
articles.snippet: LangGraph v3 introduces PostgreSQL-backed execution checkpoints that allow long-running tool-calling agents to pause for human approval, replay failed tool nodes cleanly without repeating earlier LLM turns, and inspect state diffs in production.

articles.title: How enterprises are isolating autonomous coding agents with microVM sandboxes
articles.snippet: Security engineering teams at major software firms are standardizing on ephemeral Firecracker microVMs and strict egress allowlists for autonomous coding agents, preventing SSRF attacks against cloud metadata endpoints while preserving fast build feedback loops.

cases.description: 7 RSS articles across 2 topics (4 + 3) where every article already has a rich snippet (>240 chars); expects zero unnecessary searches or scrapes.

articles.title: Form Energy switches on 100-hour iron-air battery array in Minnesota
articles.snippet: Form Energy energized its first commercial 10 MW / 1,000 MWh iron-air multi-day battery installation at a former Minnesota coal station, proving reversible iron rusting chemistry can discharge continuously across four-day winter lulls at utility scale.

articles.title: ERCOT battery storage fleet crosses 12 GW, slashing summer peak price spikes
articles.snippet: Texas grid operator ERCOT crossed 12 gigawatts of operational utility-scale batteries this month, with market monitors crediting fast-responding storage for cutting scarcity pricing hours by more than half compared to two years ago.

articles.title: North Sea HVDC interconnectors add 4.2 GW of cross-border wind transmission
articles.snippet: European transmission operators commissioned two high-voltage direct-current subsea cables totaling 4.2 GW between offshore wind arrays and coastal substations, reducing curtailment during high-wind nights across Germany, Denmark, and the UK.

articles.title: Fervo Energy begins 100 MW enhanced geothermal deliveries in Utah
articles.snippet: Fervo Energy began commercial electricity deliveries from its 100 MW Cape Station enhanced geothermal array in Utah, validating horizontal drilling techniques that cut well completion costs by 45% over two years of field operation.

articles.title: Electric Atlas humanoids begin component sequencing trial at Hyundai factory
articles.snippet: Boston Dynamics deployed a cohort of all-electric Atlas humanoids onto a Hyundai manufacturing line to sort and stage metal chassis brackets, testing autonomous vision-guided recovery when parts arrive rotated inside supply bins.

articles.title: Agility Robotics scales Oregon RoboFab plant toward 10,000 Digit units per year
articles.snippet: Agility Robotics unveiled a newly automated assembly wing at its Salem, Oregon factory aimed at producing up to 10,000 bipedal Digit robots annually for tote-handling contracts across North American distribution centers.

articles.title: Fanuc debuts 35 kg vision-guided collaborative palletizer for mixed-SKU warehouses
articles.snippet: Fanuc announced a 35-kilogram payload collaborative palletizing robot equipped with 3D structured-light cameras and force-limited joints, enabling small logistics facilities to automate mixed-box stacking without perimeter fencing.
